criterion: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.3 Label in Name (Level A)
state: first run with storage cleared, House of M imported from the catalog, home and read views both visited
method: A control is scored when it carries an aria-label and its visible text reduces to at least one word. Visible text is read from the control and its descendants, skipping any subtree that is aria-hidden or that checkVisibility() reports as not rendered, which is what a browser does when it computes the name. Both sides are reduced the same way: lowercased, with characters that are not letters, digits or marks treated as separators. A control passes when the reduced label appears as a contiguous run of words in the reduced name. Every navigation asserts that it arrived, so a view that fails to open fails the run rather than contributing unrendered controls.
